## Planned Learning Paths {#planned-paths}

These outlines describe future content; they are not yet published guides.

::: {.roadmap-details-grid}
<details class="roadmap-details">
<summary>Writing & Publishing <span>8 lessons</span></summary>

**Research Writing with Quarto (4):** setting up your writing environment; thesis chapters and dynamic citations; PDF, Word, and HTML output; collaborative writing.

**From Thesis to Publication (2):** converting chapters to journal papers; revisions, rebuttals, and reviewer comments.

**Citation Management (2):** reference managers; BibTeX, CSL styles, and citation troubleshooting.
</details>

<details class="roadmap-details">
<summary>Research Workflows <span>7 lessons</span></summary>

**Reproducible Research Fundamentals (3):** code and data organization; Git basics; documentation.

**AI & ML Research Workflows (3):** project structure; datasets and experiments; notebooks to publishable research.

**Lab Notebooks (1):** digital and paper lab notebooks.
</details>

<details class="roadmap-details">
<summary>Time & Project Management <span>6 lessons</span></summary>

**PhD Time Management (3):** weekly planning; balancing responsibilities; deep work.

**Project Management for Researchers (2):** milestones; practical tools and systems.

**Managing Multiple Projects (1):** prioritization and context switching.
</details>

<details class="roadmap-details">
<summary>Collaboration & Communication <span>6 lessons</span></summary>

**Supervisor–Student Communication (2):** meetings and progress reports; feedback and expectations.

**Co-authorship Workflows (2):** collaborative version control; division of labor and authorship discussions.

**Conference Presentations (2):** paper-to-slides; Q&A and networking.
</details>
:::
:::
